about: The LabPBR 1.3 channels as VirtualAtlas and the game both write them from the public spec (docs/specs/block-textures-spec.md, section 4.4). Not read by either program: two tests, one in Python (tools/virtual_atlas/test_pbr_files.py) and one in Rust (engine/renderer/src/block_textures.rs), check that each program's own table agrees with this file, so the two copies cannot drift apart unseen. 'byte' counts red, green, blue, alpha as 0..3 in the companion file. 'neutral' is the byte of a pixel that has no companion file. Meaning and codec vectors are added with the codecs.
